This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, to be performed
 every six months as indicated by M6 in the title block.

The condenser receives the hot steam from the steam turbine and
 condensate it to water using raw water. The raw water is flows through the
 tubes of the condenser and the steam around it.

The 
first draft initiated by eng. Dalia Harhash Abd-Elfatah, tested by eng. 
Ahmad El-Saeedy, accepted by eng. general manager eng. Khamis Elsherif
 revised 
 by MDEPC quality control eng. Abouda El Bana and approved by 
 eng. Abd Elmoaty Elrakayby head sector of Mahmoudia Power Station.

This document
 certified by eng. Samir Abd Algalil inspection & quality control

 Mohamed Nagieb Inspection and quality control head sector

items:
A work permit must be issued and 
 the maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category.

Safety fence with caution marks 
 surrounding the work area is required

Wear safety and healthy 
 equipments as safety healthy, safety shoes, ...etc.
Unit must be shut downed

Insulate inlet & outlet cooling 
 water valves on the water box

Open drain and vent valves of 
 water box to drain cooling water

Fill the hot well 
 with demy water to be above tubes level .

Be sure the 
 cooling raw water must be completely drained .

Open manholes of 
 condenser to check any leakage .
Maintenance tool set
Grease (multi purpose grease)
Cleaning fluid, rages
Brushes

Fill the steam side of the condenser with water and test the 
 condenser tubes for water leakage

Leaked tubes should be plugged with copper dowels, 
 take into consideration that max. plugged tubes are not more than 10% of the total 
 tubes
Clean the condenser tubes with water and brushes
Close inspection manholes
Close drain valves

Open inlet & outlet cooling water valves to 
 fill the water box
Close vent valves
Check inspection holes for leakage

Inspect expansion joint for external 
 surface damage (inlet )

Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, to be performed
 every six months as indicated by M6 in the title block.
The condenser receives the hot steam from the steam turbine and
 condensate it to water using raw water. The raw water is flows through the
 tubes of the condenser and the steam around it.
